## PROBLEM
The 2026-09-03..04 worktree session unknowingly built 16 pi-extensions commits on a diverged local main: python-kernel v2 (prelude, QoL, audit seam, release path, e2e smoke), service-knowledge ext v1 suite + its relocation to @jaggerxtrm/pi-service-knowledge, in-kernel binding, drift detection, READMEs/manifest blurbs, orphaned service-skills cleanup. Meanwhile origin/main shipped v0.12.0 (5 commits). The stack must be rebased onto published main and landed as a clean PR.
## SUCCESS
Linear PR from the 16-commit stack rebased onto origin/main 04c1867b: all conflicts resolved with no behavior change beyond resolution, changelog:check green, version files NOT bumped (release already cut), no global-state mutation, targeted + affected suites green, CI green, merged.
## CONSTRAINTS
Isolated worktree only; canonical /home/dawid/dev/core is on an unrelated feature branch and dirty — never touch it. Preserve the 16-commit history (rebase, no squash). No version bumps (0.12.0 already released). No npm publish, no tag.
